name: pricing-card
title: PricingCard
description: Single tier on a pricing page. Composes a plan name, price (with billing cadence + sub-line), feature list with check / cross glyphs, and a CTA. Includes 'highlight' variant for the recommended tier with the v0.12.5 peak-end lift (accent glow + lifted shadow). One highlighted tier per pricing surface (per Premium Psychology principle 3).
